name: Biomedical Sciences PhD
institution: University of North Texas Health Science Center at Fort Worth
summary: Biomedical Sciences PhD with first-year laboratory rotations to identify a dissertation mentor and discipline-specific research training.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Final application
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated; applications open Nov. 1.

applicationFee.note: $86 BioMedCAS fee plus $75 UNT Health processing fee on the linked PhD guide. No applicable waiver verified.

english.note: IELTS Academic; official scores within two years of the application deadline. International policy accepts IELTS/TOEFL and documented English-medium waiver requests; the PhD guide specifically names TOEFL, so confirm the program accepts the central alternatives. Documentation does not automatically grant a waiver.

documents: Official transcripts from every college/university; WES course-by-course evaluation of non-US education
Statement of purpose on research interests, career goals and program choice
Three signed recommendation letters on letterhead
requirements.note: Accredited bachelor’s degree required; final-semester students may apply. Core science preparation recommended, not required: biology, chemistry including organic chemistry, biochemistry, calculus or statistics. First-year rotations identify mentor/lab.

funding.note: Program states all PhD students receive $35,000/year plus tuition, fees and health insurance (amount undated), but separately says international students may qualify with proper documentation. Confirm international offer and documentation.
